# YAAP v0.1.1

Released: 2026-08-09

[日本語](https://github.com/furbon/YetAnotherAnalyzerProfiler/blob/v0.1.1/.github/release-notes/v0.1.1.ja.md)

YAAP v0.1.1 makes English the authoritative documentation language while retaining official Japanese guidance for the main user and safety journeys.

## Documentation and community

- English canonical README, user/developer documentation, community policies, contribution templates, package information, and release notes
- Official Japanese translations for README, usage, measurement, troubleshooting, security, and support
- GitHub issues and pull requests explicitly accept English or Japanese
- README badges link directly to main-branch CI, the NuGet package, and the latest GitHub Release

## Installation

```console
dotnet tool install --global YetAnotherAnalyzerProfiler.Tool
yaap version
```

Existing v0.1.0 commands and history remain compatible. There are no CLI, GUI, history-schema, measurement, operating-system, or target-framework changes in this release.

## Supply-chain maintenance

- Pull requests receive GitHub Dependency Review in addition to existing Dependabot, CodeQL, secret scanning, locked restore, SHA-pinned Actions, checksums, and provenance attestations.
- The NuGet package page uses an English embedded readme and description.
- A guarded single-input maintainer command updates the product version and active Dependabot branch for future releases.

## Security and privacy

YAAP remains a local tool with no telemetry or update checks. It is not a sandbox: target restore, build, MSBuild tasks, analyzers, and source generators can communicate or cause side effects. Inspect history, binlogs, logs, and exports before sharing them.

## Known limitation

Japanese documentation intentionally covers the main user and safety journeys rather than every developer/maintainer document. English prevails if translations differ.
